questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence with appropriate inversion for emphasis or necessity.

Which sentence correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial clause?

Options:
options: Only when the rain stopped did they continue the journey.
Only when the rain stopped do they continue the journey.
Only when the rain stopped have they continued the journey.
Only when the rain stopped will they continue the journey.
questions.answer: Only when the rain stopped did they continue the journey.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly forms a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail.

Which of the following is a grammatically correct cleft sentence that emphasizes the location?

Options:
options: It was in London that he first met her.
It was in London which he first met her.
It was in London that he met her first.
It was in London, that he first met her.
questions.answer: It was in London that he first met her.

questions.question:
Choose the correct form of the conditional sentence that demonstrates a hypothetical situation in the past with a less likely outcome.

Which option correctly uses the third conditional to express a regret about a past action with a speculative outcome?

Options:
options: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it now.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it then.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it yesterday.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it last week.
questions.answer: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it then.

questions.question:
Select the sentence that correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation or requirement.

Which of the following uses the subjunctive correctly in a formal context?

Options:
options: I suggest that the committee members attend the meeting tomorrow.
It is recommended that the committee members attend the meeting tomorrow.
It is suggested that the committee members attend the meeting tomorrow.
It is recommended that the committee members should attend the meeting tomorrow.
questions.answer: It is recommended that the committee members attend the meeting tomorrow.

questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence demonstrating ellipsis, where a word is omitted but understood from context.

Which sentence correctly uses ellipsis to avoid repetition while maintaining grammatical coherence?

Options:
options: She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his brother.
She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his.
She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his brother.
She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his own brother.
questions.answer: She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his brother.
